$comment: Held-major exceptions, read by scripts/gates/check-deps.ts (operator ruling 2026-10-01).

A blocklisted npm major (.ci/policy/.deps-upgrade-blocklist) is aged from the first stable, non-deprecated release of the first line past its current version. It warns at 60 days and FAILS at 90 unless an entry here excuses it.

Key: blocklist grammar, '<package>' or '<dir>:<package>'. A scoped key applies to its own manifest; a bare key applies to every manifest the bare blocklist line covers. The key must match a blocklist line.
Entry: owner (^[A-Za-z0-9._@-]{3,}$), reason (the BLOCKER quality rules: 30+ characters, no banned phrase), and EXACTLY ONE of:

blocker: {kind: 'peer-range', package: P, peer: Q, excludes: L} -- live while P@latest declares a peer range for Q that no stable, non-deprecated Q on line L satisfies; or {kind: 'engine-floor', engine: 'node'} -- live while the judged manifest's engines.node floor major is below the clock line's major. Re-checked against the registry on every run.
expires: 'YYYY-MM-DD', at most 30 days after the run judging it. Extending it takes a new commit.

The gate fails on an entry that is expired, whose blocker has lifted (stale), or that matches no blocklist-held major in the run (dead). Liveness is in-gate: the oracle is the registry, and check-suppression-liveness is offline by rule.
Seeded 2026-10-01; ages measured that day with the registry's time map.
